code_summary: Intended architecture: position-free NextItNet with 64-dimensional item embeddings, maximum length 128, and eight independent causal convolution blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8] and kernel size 3. Blocks retain gated GELU convolutions, LayerNorm, dropout 0.2, and learned residual scales initialized to 0.1. Padding masks, final normalization, last-nonpadding selection, and tied item scoring are preserved in the design. The submitted source does not correctly implement the intended ablation.
